utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can take a look at the supply list and handle whatever needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks. I heard the supply table still needs tools, extension cords, and canned food, so I can pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, I’ll check those out and see what else still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Nell, the repair drive is still gathering tools, extension cords, and canned food for the supply table. I can check what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, I can help with checking the tools and sorting the donation boxes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Noah. I’ll keep checking the tool pile and donation boxes, and I’ll let Nell know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Faye can coordinate after drop-off. I’ll let Gus know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect. I’ll coordinate with Faye after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oren’s ready to help, and I can write out the repair drive tasks and assignments clearly so we keep track of every commitment.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, that keeps us organized. I’ll make sure Mina’s delivery is ready at the church hall on Maple Street at 10.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, I’ll add Mina’s delivery to the list so every commitment stays clear and on track.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is actually happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, it is. Vik said he can help out too, so we’ve got some backup.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, looks like it is. Glad Vik’s pitching in too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, folks are supposed to bring whatever tools they can spare for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can help with the repairs. I’ll wait for the list before I write anything down.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, just jot down the tools you can bring when the list comes by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right, Vik was mentioning the repair drive to a few of us. I should check in and see what they need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the locations so the list stays clear. Jules has the drill and screws, and Rosa’s got the sign-up sheet sorted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good, then we just need to keep the list tight and make sure everyone knows where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Noah can help with the repair drive. I'll ask him.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, and Cleo’s got the tarps and zip ties covered.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good. I’ll check on Noah and keep the line moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate tonight if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That'd help. Tess said folks should bring whatever tools they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it, I’ll bring the tools I can spare and help sort things out tonight.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Jules can pick which part of the repair drive to repeat back. I can help keep it moving, and Ira should have the tasks that need doing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That works, and I’ll keep the volunteers posted once the repair list is set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Rosa, I’ll keep handing the repair list to the neighbors who need it, and Jules can still choose what gets repeated back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll bring everything to the church hall on Maple Street at 10.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll let folks know: back porch rail and the loose steps by the alley gate.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it, I’ll note those two spots.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, but I still need Quinn’s exact address and time before I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Gus is sorting the last few jobs, and I can help with the rest once Quinn sends the address and time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right, I can’t plan around it until Quinn sends the exact address and time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Tess said folks should bring whatever tools they can spare to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. I’ll bring a wrench if I still have one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Rey said they'd help, so we've got one more set of hands for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure Rey can make it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: He said he’d try to make it, and I’ve got a backup if he can’t.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, they said to bring whatever tools you can spare for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Vik said they can help with the repair drive, so I should ask them what tools they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Right, and they should ask Vik what kind of tools they can bring so we don’t end up with duplicates.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Right, the repair drive is underway. What time did you want me there?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Tell Jules which part of the repair drive you want repeated, and I can help keep it moving. I can also bring the relevant tasks for Ira.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which part should I repeat for Jules?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll bring everything to the church hall on Maple Street at 10.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll let Vik know and stop by after I finish these errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira. See you at the hall at 10.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can help with that. I’ll check the tools and sort the donation boxes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with the last few repair jobs on Saturday if you still need me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate it tonight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll spread the word and let folks know what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can keep a clear list of the repair drive tasks and who’s doing what. Oren’s here and ready to help, so let’s put the assignments down now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can ask Noah to take one of the heavier jobs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, let’s list the jobs now so Rosa can see them clearly and we can keep track of who’s taking the heavy work.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can help with the repairs, but I’ll wait for the list before I write anything down.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mina’s bringing everything to the church hall on Maple Street at 10, so the list should be there too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, I’ll wait there and write it down once I see the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is gathering tools, extension cords, and canned food for the supply table.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Faye can help coordinate after drop-off. We just need to keep the table sorted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I’ll keep an eye on the table sorting and the drop-off list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Opal. I’ll match each repair to the right spot and keep the volunteers posted once the list is set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’m keeping the locations straight so the list stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, and once Mara has the commitments lined up, I’ll tell everyone exactly where to show up and help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can help with that, Bo. Just point me at the supply list and I’ll take whatever needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Cleo’s got the tarps and zip ties covered, so just grab anything else on the list and we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, I’ll take whatever’s left on the list and check with Mara if I need direction.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
